goal: Separate publisher/source gaps, DDS receive backlog, Unitree SDK listener/BQueue delay, Python scheduling, and camera-load effects without creating a robot command path.

phases.name: deployment_static_gate
requirements: local and remote profiler SHA-256 match
pinned Unitree SDK and CycloneDDS versions match
AST and token scan finds no send channel, command publisher, mode switch, motion client, subprocess, or shell API

phases.name: four_condition_paired_diagnostic
phases.camera_lifecycle: Start only for camera_on segments; verify all three streams before each segment and full process/port/device cleanup after each segment.

root_cause_rules.observation: application gap >50 ms, source gap <=50 ms, direct batch size >1
root_cause_rules.classification: reader or process scheduling backlog candidate

root_cause_rules.observation: source timestamp gap >50 ms in both direct and SDK paths
root_cause_rules.classification: publisher or transport delivery gap candidate

root_cause_rules.observation: SDK path >50 ms while direct path remains <=50 ms under matched camera state
camera_on materially increases paired gap or backlog metrics in both paths

root_cause_rules.classification: candidate identity is insufficient; do not claim sample uniqueness

fail_closed_requirements.any_capture_error: stop current phase and keep H3 false
fail_closed_requirements.any_receive_gap_over_50ms: record provisional stale hold and keep Policy Shadow locked
fail_closed_requirements.any_camera_cleanup_failure: stop all later runs and verify cleanup
